summary: Keep sign-in-gated partial catalog walks out of authoritative sync snapshots.
reason: A catalog walk can collect rows from one location before a later class, camp, or booking-menu request hits a customer sign-in gate. Promoting that partial result made drift report unseen entities as removed.
validated_outcome: PASS: focused gate-completeness regressions, full Go tests, go vet, go build, 134/134 live dogfood checks, verify-skill, PII audit, supply-chain scan, and publish validation passed.
findings_addressed: Greptile P1: sign-in-gated partial catalog walks could create false removals in drift
reapply_notes: Preserve icpCollection.Gated across location, class, camp, and booking-menu reads. An authoritative snapshot requires both resource kinds, no page truncation, and no sign-in gate. Re-run TestIcpCollectMarksPartialSignInGateIncomplete and TestIcpSyncSnapshotCompleteRequiresWholeCatalog.
